accountingRace.environment: Paper 26.1.2 build 74, Java 25, MariaDB 11.4.5, internal accounting sink
accountingRace.method: In a zero-player local lab, hold the event table lock, invalidate through the public method, submit a real projection read through its private tick, observe its SQL waiting on the lock, invalidate again, release the lock and consume the actual successful old-generation completion. The console probe briefly holds the main thread for coordination; no snapshot, completion, generation, clock or readiness value is injected.
accountingRace.baseline: Old completion rejected; snapshot absent and readiness false. Ordinary ticks subsequently publish a newer snapshot.
accountingRace.observed: Old snapshot accepted and readiness true after invalidation

nativeProviderArtifactComparison.result: The pin matches the concrete provider's own JAR and SHA; the API JAR has a different SHA

publicNativeProbeCheck.baseline: PASS: successful old completion rejected; snapshot absent and readiness false
publicNativeProbeCheck.mutant: FAILED: the exact stale-generation assertion detects old snapshot readiness
publicNativeProbeCheck.duplicateReportLabel: Refused before running another check; original report unchanged
publicNativeProbeCheck.scope: Same empty-server setup and private tick coordination; no player/account/property/money fixtures or field injection

coverageLimits: The component command and native probe are available; complete billing fault reproduction and release acceptance remain unfinished
